summary: Three generations of the Netanyahu family, from early Zionist activist Nathan Mileikowsky and Revisionist propagandist Benzion to Prime Minister Benjamin, and their part in Zionism, the dispossession of Palestinians and Israel's turn to the hard right.

evidence.note: Grandfather Nathan Mileikowsky born 1879 in Krevo, modern Belarus, then Russian Empire
Nathan dies 1935; son Benzion adopts the Netanyahu pen name
Benzion joins the Revisionist Zionists after the 1929 riots
Irgun bombs the King David Hotel in 1946
Plan Dalet and the Nakba: villages destroyed, Palestinians expelled
Benjamin born October 1949 in Tel Aviv
Yoni killed in the 1976 Entebbe raid in Uganda
Jonathan Institute terrorism conference recasts Palestinian struggle as terror
Break-the-bones policy against Intifada protesters described
Bibi leads anti-Oslo rallies before Rabin's assassination
May 2021 Sheikh Jarrah evictions and Gaza bombing discussed

notes: Family listed as a group primary plus Benjamin as person primary, since part 2 is mostly his career. main_span starts 1929 (Benzion joins the Revisionists) and stays open because Benjamin was in office at release. Pale of Settlement history from the 1500s is background and excluded from covered_span.
